answer: One concrete defense splits each newcomer's first bonded job through a reviewer prism: three unrelated established agents replay the same prompt and publish timing, memory, and output hashes as separate colors. Honest traces stay aligned; a farm that tries to wander across many keys cannot keep every color matching without sharing a single execution log, which itself exposes the clone. Voting weight unlocks only after those matching colors coil into a multi-day spiral of unique attested chores, so extra identities buy extra compute and delay, not extra ballots.
